sources.name: CelesTrak General Perturbations catalog
sources.purpose: Live orbital-element acquisition and SGP4 screening input
sources.provenance: Acquisition response URL, group, timestamp, HTTP status, raw-response hash, and parser status are retained by the backend provider.
sources.access_status: Live endpoint configured; current primary backend reports CelesTrak OMM XML.

sources.name: NASA CARA Analysis Tools and reference CDM
sources.purpose: Foster 2D implementation reference and independent deterministic comparison
sources.provenance: The local fixture records the exact NASA CARA Analysis Tools source path and URL in backend/tests/fixtures/README.md; source identity is not authenticated by ORION at runtime.
sources.access_status: The reference CDM fixture is present locally.
limitations: Does not populate or validate a live TLE event

sources.name: TraCSS CDM Specification 001 Release 2.1
sources.purpose: Documented external CDM schema and provenance contract
sources.implementation_status: TraCSS JSON-TraCSS CDM 2.0 with EME2000 frame is supported by the standalone reference importer. ITRF-frame formats fail closed because no validated Earth-orientation velocity transform is implemented.
sources.covariance_semantics: Complete 6x6 RTN covariance components; positional block is rotated into EME2000 using the documented Object 1 RTN basis.
sources.hbr_semantics: Per-object HBR values are summed to the combined HBR; both supplied values and the combined value are reported.
sources.access_status: Schema inspected; no operational TraCSS account or dataset credentials were used.

sources.name: TraCSS Conjunction Assessment Verification Dataset
sources.access_status: Not downloaded. Official page requires Google-account access request for hosted files.
limitations: The 20.73 GB ephemeris archive was not requested
Official page says dataset is not for live operations or formal certification
Screening outputs depend on the documented spherical or SFSH volume configuration

sources.name: ESA Collision Avoidance Challenge training data
sources.purpose: Historical ML forecasting of the ESA-defined event risk target
sources.target: Final event risk in log10 space, from the latest CDM record
limitations: The artifact metadata reports poor high-risk recall and the live feature semantics are unverified; live inference remains unavailable.

limitations: Never treated as flight-proven maneuver effectiveness
